thread:
maria: Follow-up from the postmortem for the weekend recurring 99p spikes on /generate during batch windows. We need clear owners, short timelines, and an SLO cohort proposal that doesn't shift global SLAs.

owen: I'll own the batching/queue changes. Plan: split long-seq (>1100) into a separate queue, cap its batch window to 5ms, and add qps backpressure for that queue. PR will include metrics for queue-wait and head-of-line time. ETA: Wed EOD. PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/opt-batcher/pulls/117

felix: I'll take dashboards and alert tuning. Current 95/99 combined alerts are noisy. I'll add a 99p page rule and an error-budget burn panel (30m burn-rate) and attach a small runbook. ETA: Thu morning. Dashboard (staging) will be posted.

incident-bot: Incident I-7482 created and linked to postmortem. Label: recurring-latency-pattern.

maria: For SLO tweak, prefer cohort-based temp adjustment: 5 days for requests with header X-Model: huge-only. Rebecca, can you draft an RFC with rollback gates and communication checklist?

rebecca: Yes. Draft will include rollback gate: 99p < 1.05s for 3h and error-budget burn under 1.5x for 6h. I'll add PM/CS notification templates and a short status email snippet. ETA: Fri morning. RFC link when ready.

owen: Canary plan after PR merge: 24h at 10% then 24h at 30% if stable. Metrics to watch: 99p latency by model, queue wait, CPU/GPU util, and error-rate. Will add canary dashboard links.

felix: Alert draft (staging):
```
alert: High99LatencyByModel
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route)) > 1.2
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
```
I'll attach runbook: scale dedicated pool, route to fallback variant, and enable prefix cache.

maria: Ownership summary: batching + canary = owen; alerts + dashboards = felix; SLO cohort RFC & comms = rebecca; I'll own cross-team notifications and add dates to I-7482. Please add tasks to the incident board with explicit date fields.

owen: Added milestones to I-7482 and linked PR + canary plan.

felix: Posted staging dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/klmn4567/latency-burn (staging).

rebecca: RFC draft posted: https://docs.internal/slo/7482-cohort-temp-adjust.md. Includes cohort selector, rollback criteria, and communication templates.

maria: Weekly check-in Mon 09:00 to review canary telemetry and error-budget trajectory. If we get pages before then, tag them with "recurring-latency" so we can aggregate. Keep updates short in this thread.

owen: Monitoring canary now, will post any regressions.

maria: Thanks everyone 44D
